regions.name: protected_boot_manager
regions.purpose: ROM-invoked flash BSL, target/signature verification and fail-closed slot selection

regions.name: application_a
regions.purpose: running or last-known-good controller image including its manifest and signature

regions.name: application_b
regions.purpose: inactive/pending controller image including its manifest and signature

regions.name: boot_state
regions.purpose: duplicated version, compatibility, pending/confirmed state and bounded fault metadata

policy: two identical maps are built independently for pack and safety controllers; warn above 20 KiB and reject a packaged slot image above 22 KiB
